source_issues.source_claim: Document EER snippet returns an equal-error estimate and threshold.
source_issues.concern: The initial best=(1,1,0) has zero FA-FR gap. No nonnegative absolute gap can be strictly smaller, so all finite nonempty cases return (1,0), even perfectly separated data. Actual main.py uses best_gap=inf and is a different algorithm.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Faithfully preserved original prose/code/formulas/SVG; issue disclosed separately without source edits or validator exceptions.

source_issues.source_claim: An EER threshold makes false acceptance equal false rejection.
source_issues.concern: main.py only samples observed thresholds, averages unequal rates, retains the lowest threshold for equal-gap ties, and does not interpolate the crossing or test an above-maximum endpoint. same=[.2,.8], diff=[.4] returns (.75,.4), although the equally close threshold .8 gives .25. All-equal data returns .5 with FA=1 and FR=0.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Faithfully preserved original prose/code/formulas/SVG; issue disclosed separately without source edits or validator exceptions.

source_issues.source_claim: EER operates on same-speaker and different-speaker score lists.
source_issues.concern: One empty class causes division by zero. Two empty classes return (.5,0) in main.py and (1,0) in the documentation, despite no meaningful trials.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Faithfully preserved original prose/code/formulas/SVG; issue disclosed separately without source edits or validator exceptions.

source_issues.concern: True cosine is invariant to positive rescaling. The documentation formula gives 1 for [3,4] and [6,8]; main.py computes their raw dot product as 50 and relies on earlier L2 normalization. zip silently truncates unequal dimensions. The mean of normalized enrollment vectors need not have unit norm.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Faithfully preserved original prose/code/formulas/SVG; issue disclosed separately without source edits or validator exceptions.

source_issues.source_claim: MFCC-statistical embedding illustrates the main implementation.
source_issues.concern: The documentation calls featurize_mfcc while the implementation defines featurize. The documentation returns raw mean+std while main.py L2-normalizes. frame_signal creates an unpadded short frame, and STFT indexes the full frame length, causing IndexError. hann(1) and zero hop divide by zero.
